G1 on all six paths per box + total (NEW masks, L9 for FS), the L4 J rule in every cell (incl. slow WR J48: M-1), G1c slow + medium vs AA7, L5 start / stop (stepcnt), G6 flash (stepped + real loop), first-motion hitch, and the look of the FS / WR / RS waterlines on reverse and fast (x1 / x2 strips vs AA7, BASE, GT). LENS = ARTIFACTS / REFLECTION. Pop scan (popscan / popnew, bloom-free masks) on slow, medium, fast, diag, reverse, leave and hold, AA8 vs AA7; the thin-tip spot (AR-1 b / RC-1) at scale 1, 0.8 and 0.7 (gov, holdre k203-211, an ordinary pointer sweep) at x1 and x4 - gone?; the rest look under every floe vs AA7 and the 2x GT (R-1 / R-2 / R-4 spots); the hold (crest train, rings' reflection, release / re-press); the knee effect (jgt2 thin-dark and the waterline thin lines vs GT); the WebGL context loss / restore frames (P-1); G5 hero / sky unchanged; G3 texture.
